craft_claim: Applying sacred register to a non-sacred or mastered object produces false solemnity and unearned profundity; abstraction and vagueness are not depth signals and can be exposed by paraphrase.

supporting_evidence.note: Participants rated syntactically well-formed but semantically empty 'bullshit' statements as profound, with low reflectiveness predicting receptivity; genuine profundity was distinguishable from pseudo-profound stimuli.

supporting_evidence.location: Shared claim: unearned emotion exceeds established stakes
supporting_evidence.note: Borrowed gravity is the register-level parallel of melodrama: the emotional demand exceeds what the material establishes.
When awe is manufactured by power and fear rather than earned by a compelling object, it shades into threat rather than reverence.

exceptions: Genre frames that knowingly foreground pomp (camp, satire, pastiche) may use borrowed gravity as a deliberate effect.
